description: Use this when the user needs available models for standalone image, image editing, video clip, or text generation. type=image for generate_image, image_edit for edit_image, video for generate_video, text for generate_text. Music and voice models are listed by list_music_models. Then call get_model_help for parameters and prices of one image, image_edit, or video model. This lists models rather than starting generation. For song-driven music, dance, or lyric videos, use generate_music_video, generate_dance_video, or generate_lyric_video.
name: list_models

outputSchema.description: On success, returns the tool result fields. On error, returns success:false, error and code, with optional credit approval details; success-only fields are absent.

models.description: Available models. Media models carry model_id; text models carry model.
